topic: R24 TABLESTYLE per-style margin override transport

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
fields: BS group 171 margin override flags; bit 1 indicates overrides

implementation.profile: Each R24 cell style independently admits margin flag 0 only with all-zero payload, or flag 1 with finite nonnegative values. The former all-custom-styles-equal and exact 0.06/0.18 restrictions are removed; other fields remain on the existing exact style profile.

styles: Table cell style: explicit default margins
Header: inherited margins with zero payload

checks: Typed readback compares each of the six values and the override flag against its source style.
Raw group-40 order and group-171 flags are compared against the serialized per-style sequence.
Negative and infinite margins, an unsupported override flag, and a nonzero payload with override flag zero are refused with destination preservation.
Corrected data succeeds on the same adapter after refusal.
control.fixture_policy: No DWG/DXF fixture is committed; output is temporary and removed.

limits: This establishes generated serializer/readback transport for finite nonnegative per-style margins.
It does not establish native table layout/rendering, physical DWG producer coverage, arbitrary undocumented override flags, or whole-source conversion.
AC1027 aggregate source-reference and HEADER gates are unchanged.
